# pve_ceph_mgr (Resource)

One Ceph manager on a node; item_id is the manager id (API placeholder id).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_mgr" "example" {
item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The ID for the manager, when omitted the same as the nodename. (default: nodename)
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
